clinician.final_diagnosis: Soft tissue pathology demonstrated spindle cell proliferation, consistent with DF.
clinician.trajectory_summary: A woman in her 60s presented with escalating abdominal pain and a midline lump three weeks after elective scoliosis surgery. Initial CT suggested a small hematoma. Despite this, symptoms persisted. The definitive diagnosis was made based on soft tissue pathology of the abdominal lump, which demonstrated spindle cell proliferation, consistent with Desmoid Fibromatosis (DF).
